Name: "Kage"
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the forests surrounding Sakai, after a failed Kitsune expedition from the south.
- Her parent, instead of leaving her to the elements choose to excommunicate themselves from Sakai
- Years later the child would return to Sakai, now changed and alone
- Taking up the name "Kage", she'd become a Disciple under the leader of Sakai, seeking to learn balance and perhaps one day reverse whatever have caused their body to change
- Despite never fully fitting in, she'd find companionship with several new pupils who see her for the warrior she is, and not the monster that others see
- Having reached a plateau in her cultivation, her master suggested her to leave for the deserts. To either overcome her trials, or to do what many before her has and slaughter Yokai.
- Seeking a better alternative for the people of Sakai, she'd try and overcome her trials, only to be left in a pool of her own blood. Not long after she was caught in an all too familiar storm, lifting her to the worldhelm.
Quirk:
Qi Specialist : Void
Change damage to Air | Resistant to Air | Weak to Light | Able to preform Void domain arcanism rituals

Name: "Trillion"
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Has served Kuzunoha since before the Maddening
- Was once a Witch of a great Circle
- His people have long since died, and he has markings of a demon
- Now seeks to restore Kuzunoha to her former glory
- Believes exercising pacifism is the way to do this.

Name: A'shibah
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born the seventh son of a Hiear merchant family.
- Family was killed; but used his body to shield his twin brother, Levan
- Levan failed a ritual to revive the family, A'shibah took the consequence by making a deal with Akhir
- A'shibah promised his soul to oblivion, but Musta'khan managed to save him by binding the brothers together
- Now lives inside of Levan, sharing the same soul vessel
Sheet Link: [*"No one hurts my brother... except for me!"*](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/136lDqDNwMlPUoXgLkyJLYlqSFSXfNx9x0LwqPGY77g8/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

Name: AVA
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Ava is an Elden automaton, created for the purpose of entertaining an Elden Child. She and the Elden child regularly played pretend. Where she began to absorb the ideals of a heroic soldier.

-The Rapture came, and she was entombed in the chaos and destruction. Refusing to disobey her rules to wind herself up, she fell into a deep slumber.

-She was awoken by the New Empire, now truly believing her instilled values to be fact, she worked as a soldier under the new empire. Attempting to become a hero unknowingly chasing the goal she had before she lost her memories.

-During her service, she began to surpass the rules her creators had given her, becoming more independent. Even learning to wind her own mechanism.

-She was dishonorably discharged for disobeying her superiors orders to save more lives.

-Unable to comprehend her being discharged for doing the right thing, she joins the adventurer's guild, assuming proving herself would allow her to return to the New Empire in glory.

Name: Abigail Byrne
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grew up in Snowmaw parents died raised by her grandmother

-Grandmother taught her magic and told her stories of the fae 

-As a teenager she grew to love nature and outdoors help out foraging for Helga’s shop

-Her magic grew as she got older she crafted a broom that made her and her alone capable of flight

-Bound her raven as a familiar with the aid of her grandmother

-Was a wilderness guide as an adult, in her latest trek she got caught up in a snowstorm that had a realmstorm hidden within and transported to the Worldhelm

Name: Abigail Torren
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the southern colonies rather happily into a NTT loyal family.

Spent their early years helping out with some of the animals as part of the preservation and caretaking duties of NTT.

In their teens a accident happened prepping a creature for transport to another company leading to them losing their arm

NTT offered a new test implant in exchange for free surgery, this offer was taken. The process however messed with several connections to the brain leading to easily overstimulation and shut down in situations (making their already existing issues worse)

They were however thankful to NTT for the help and as soon as old enough started work for them assisting in some of the terraforming operations. Slowly working further north as they proved themself

Nowadays they have switched to freelance with NTT's approval on SPEAR station, operating on contract to assist with any efforts needed by NTT in the region/helping anyone who needs it when they have free time.

Name: Adelphel Durand
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Adelphel was initially a formless spirits that simply existed in nature until captured by a Necromancer to be used in a magical experiment for a subservient creation in the wake of recent disasters. They were augmented, altered and bound into a humanoid body, however all the changes caused instability in the magic and retained free will to act independently. Deemed a failure as a result.
- They have traveled throughout Kor'Tarion helping those they come across of all kinds when able without discrimination.
- They offer aid for many issues, from things like helping with a farm or defending people from life or death situations, doing so without want of reward in return.
- They appears to be a knight of some kind in attire but holds no real symbol nor claims any titles.
- They don't appear to have memories of their past, in a sense of they remember having parents and living in a nice village but nothing solid. The lack of past and memories causes them to cherish new meetings.

Name: Aelina Van Deivoet
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to the once Royal House of Deivoet, Aelina is a third generation Lost. Her family having once been something of great import in their home realm, they have faded since becoming part of Ripplith.

-Her family is know for storm magic, the ability to summon and control the weather, which earns them a spot among the more noble houses of Ripplith, but under the High Queen.

-Aelina enrolls in the prestigious Gnosis Academy in Heartdom due to pressure from her Famiy and expectations placed on her as the next Matriarch of the house.

-She becomes part of the House of Treasures using her skills in magic to rise to near the top of her class before committing it the Rite of Arms, taking the form of a ring blade.

-Later, when about to commit to her Reagent  Caspian Riviera in the ceremony of Binding, she is rejected by him in front of the entire school. Afterwards she spirals, but is trying so very hard to build herself back up to be the Regalia she knows she can be.

Name: Aer Drasil
Backstory Bullet Points:
- **Heroic End**: Fell in battle defending her people against a relentless enemy.  

- **Arrival in Idyll**: Awoke in *Asga*, an afterlife of endless duels, trials of might, and warrior camaraderie—a paradise for her spirit.  

- **Corruption of Asga**: Peace was shattered as honor turned to madness, battles became depraved slaughter, and death tainted the hallowed fields.  

- **Becoming a Valkyrie**: Refusing despair, she took up her spear again, her indomitable will transforming her into a Valkyrie.  An Angel of Nimue.

- **Salmon’s Reach**: Found refuge in this sanctuary and became one of its protectors.  

- **Purpose Beyond**: With Vanagandr slain, Aer now must discover what her path is beyond her original aim.

Name: Aerah
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born with a magical mutation that causes her voice to be volatile if uncontrolled, as such she was told not to speak.
- Due to an outburst she ended up accidently killing one of her bullies as a child and harming other.
- This lead to law suits putting her family into debt, which her mother tried to gamble to get out of.
- 777LC saw potential with Aerah's talents and offered her a job to help pay off her family's debt. This lead to her joining their Roller Derby circut that people bet on.
Quirk: Heirloom: Vocal Stabilizer - Flaw - When trying to speak or using abilities that require creatures to hear you this device may malfunction.

Name: Agata Nergath
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Hidela to Annalise Augustein and Milo Nergath. Annalise was a volunteer in the early Demon hosting process. It severely effected her health, as she died shortly after giving birth to Agata

- Agata managed to somehow inherit her Esper Abilities from her mother, purifying it into a demon of positive energy. 

- In her adolescence she had to live out in Hidela’s junkyard as her powers where uncontrollable and dangerous to those around her.

- When she was able to manage them, she returned to her father with an intense love of mechanics.

- after joining with the worldhelm she merged with her Demon, Agerion, to become a joined entity.

- she is the current custodian of the Font of Joy, a shard of positive soul network than she intends to use to heal the network at large.

Name: Aijing Minli
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Had a decent childhood, despite beeing a Bishè
- Eventually corrupt cultivators took notice
- His parents got sacrificed to further the corrupt cultivators power
- got taken in by Hengs master
- discovered he has an affinity for cultivation, but also healing. (with medicinal tools)
- found an aincent manuscript of the legendary alchemist Keng Sien-Seng
- stopped cultivating for a bit in order to fulltime heal people, eventually returned to it.
- got called onto the worldhelm while running away from corrupt cultivators
Birth Realm: Tian Yin | Wujing gao | Xuanwu City
Quirk:
Hunted Emissary
Boon of Auspicious Wisdom
(Divination)

Name: Akahime Fuyumi
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Akahime, a serpentine yokai, has wandered the frozen land of Aldistir for nearly a decade guiding lost souls to their next destination.

- At the Grasping Tree, she found the Night Lantern: a glowing, chained staff that seems to comfort those who have succumbed to fear and marks her as a beacon for both the lost and the dangerous.

- As her presence began drawing attention, she trained to defend herself and protect the innocents she ferried from predators and vengeful entities.

- She encountered corrupted beings, especially draugr, and took it upon herself to cleanse them and guide them back into the soul cycle.

- Lost within a realmstorm, she found her way to the Worldhelm, where she embraced a greater calling—extending her duties beyond Aldistir to other realms.

- Now, she travels between worlds, learning their secrets and continuing her quiet mission: to protect, guide, and redeem the lost and the damned.
Quirk:
Heirloom:
The Night Lantern guides the lost—those whose spirits wander through the bleak blizzards where even Akahime’s sirenic voice cannot reach. Yet, the lantern’s light pierces through. Suspended from its chain at the end of her staff, it offers a sense of control, comfort, and quiet confidence to those nearby. In her hands, it becomes more than a beacon—it is a weapon, radiant and resolute, used to banish darkness in all its forms. Unfortunately, not everything the lantern attracts is friendly...

Custom Item: 
Base Form: Arcane, melee, [HR+7], [WIL + WIL], Transforming, Magic Defense Boost, Defense Boost, Damage type: Light
Transformation: Flail, melee, [HR+12], [DEX + WIL], Transforming, Accurate, Powerful, Damage type: Light
Rare Item Quality: Harmonious, Damage Change - Light

Name: Akar Ceba
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Solitary Shepherd of his large flock of sheep
- Living in Paradise, spending time taking care of his flock, his home and friends and family, unaware of what is happening in the realm or the Sea as a whole
- Goes off to find a missing sheep one day 
- Finds it, but gets swept away by a Realmstorm and lands on the Helm

Name: Akiko
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Ishiyama, slave under the ruling Oni clans. Along with the other children of her village, she was delegated to the mines.
- As a teenager, her affinity for Fire Qi was discovered. One of the higher ranking Oni in the current ruling Oni clan, Junichiro, took Akiko to the Temple of the Rising Sun to put her to work as a smith in order to craft weapons and armor with the old broken relics littering the ruin.
- Years later, in the quiet of night as she cleaned the temple, Akiko stumbled into a hidden passage that led her to a room-  a shield split down the center, each half laying in a corner and casting a soft glow across the stones.
- Curious, she lay the two halves together, and in an instant the hopeless fog in her mind burned away. She grabbed a half in each hand and raced away from the temple, pursued by Junichiro into a thunderstorm and nearly tumbling off a cliff before being swept away in a Realmstorm.
Quirk:
Heirloom - Amaterasu's Relic Shield
Akiko has obtained two halves of one runic shield that was once a relic of Amaterasu. Though split in half, they still hold onto an echo of the magic they once had.  

Radiant Runic Half: [Runic Shield (150z)] + [Memorize (650z) Flare Spell]
Sanctuary Runic Half: [Runic Shield (150z)] + [Antistatus (500z) Poisoned Condition]

Susanoo's anger towards his ashamed sister chases these shields even across realms. Wherever these shield halves are, storms pursue. Upon Tian Yan, Susanoo's followers seek out this broken relic, and the pieces are a beacon to hungering Yokai.

Name: Alaska Vertigo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Experimental LUA backup of a Lorel.AI software engineer, intended to be brought online in the event of the original's death.
- Circumstances under which she was *actually* brought online are still unknown, as is what she did immediately after.
- First thing she remembers is rebooting on the floor of an abandoned gas station in Central, connected to a bunch of probably stolen hardware.
- All memory files between that and initially coming online are corrupted.
- Quickly finds out she's also a fugitive.
- Goes to ground and ends up doing work for shadier individuals to pay for maintenance, using her expertise with the soul network.
- Gnawing questions in the back of her head about who she is and what she was doing before the entire time.
- Eventually gets wrapped up in escapades of some Goldhearted, and jumps at the chance to get on board the Worldhelm and evade Terra's authorities longer-term.

Name: Albreich Surtova
Backstory Bullet Points:
✦He was born to a family of knights in Brightshield and raised to become one in the future.

✦For many years he aspired to become a knight of great renown but as he became more familiar with their work he became disillusioned with the ideas of chivalry and whatnot that they touted so proudly.

✦Before he was to be knighted, he departed for Tradefair, From that day forth he would serve his own interests rather than the crown's.

✦Life outside the capital was rough and he would struggle to make do without the luxuries he could once afford. He would get used to it with time but he would miss the comfort of his old bed from time to time.

✦Two years after his departure he would join the Golden Claw Mercenaries. In them he saw what the knights of Brightshield should have been and though he lathes to acknowledge it, the flickering embers of chivalry would start to ignite in his heart.

Name: Alder
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Lived primarily within his mother's domain with his nomadic peoples, the Deerfolk, following the guidance of the elementals through a Hearer, nurturing life in the process. 
- Before he showed up on the Worldhelm, he was suddenly, mysteriously, shunted out of the domain, and can't find his way back or his family.
- His mother was part of the Spring Court and managed to get in Caladrius' favor to bestow some of his power on Alder to protect him. (he doesn't know this)

Name: Alec Lyon
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a working class family in Babyl City, Dawnstar Valley.
- Has a natural gift of controlling light and spiritual magic.
- Attended school normally, where he met and befriended Mae Lavery who was a grade year above him.
- Enrolled into a NTTech college that focuses on training mages, and hiring them after. He started working as a magic detective after graduating.
- Due to budget reasons, ended up moving into an apartment with Mae about 3 years prior. Then eventually formed a romantic relationship with her.
- 1 year prior to today, Mae Lavery suffered a tragic accident and died. Then she became an Insolvent with a debt over her head. Doing their best to live with the circumstances.
- Thanks to the use of his own spiritual magic and martial training, he was able to successfully mitigate casualties during the events of the Skyfall. Soon leading him to arrive on the Worldhelm, becoming a Goldhearted.

Name: Alejandra "Iron Vein"
Backstory Bullet Points:
* A creation of a artisan of Barza, a species of plant that could mold itself but stay solid as iron. A species known as Iron Veins. 
* TUBALCAIN saw the creation and deemed it unfit in his grand design. The artisan was eradicated shortly after.
* Even partially destroyed, a single section of iron vein survived and from there grew despite Barza's environment. It eventually grew into the discarded suit of armor. 

* Inhabiting the suit, the iron vein gained sentience and a sense of self. Wandering the layers, where it picked up the name Alejandra from a passing Nirve Caravan.
* With a sense of longing for identity, and a fresh soul in a land of wandering. It felt drawn to the call.
Sheet Link: [Walking in the skin of a past soul, just who are we?](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1xyGnsU-fai-OBW0JofqC_a7REKDjOt4IVDF_w8FJSWU/edit?usp=sharing)

Name: Alexander Romani
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and Raised in Mount Providence having a passion for classical songs by hearing it from a radio

- Passed away due to illness before he could get a proper start in the singing industry and became an insolvent due loans from education as well as equipment

- After almost a decade of trying to pay the debt off working entry level jobs in Central, Alexander moved back to Mount Providence almost ready to give up and become a ghoul.

- Instead his passion for the classical music reignites as he a found a old oprea piece and sang his heart out.

- With a new sense of duty he goes out to abandon buildings and churches to find more pieces like the one he found that day to preserve them so that others can still listen

- Currently works at a SWORD affiliated branch at the Fortune Valley Casino where he entertains guests with songs and help remix classic sheet music for SWORD to reuse in their products.

- Got picked up by the realmstorm when scavenging for more antiques

Name: Alexandra Stuart Lancastrian
Backstory Bullet Points:
"* Born to the Prestigious Lancastrian Noble Family. Her father, Charles, is a Mid level Noble in charge of administration of one of the larger Imperial Provinces

* Was always a brilliant girl, and to many considered a Prodigy. 

* Joined the military on her 18th birthday.

* At 25, she was placed as part of the Sky Service, working on the Vigilant Watch to hunt down people who Violate the Delver's Code.

* Six months ago, upon the retirement of her Captain, Johannes Kranston, she was promoted to Captain.

* Two months ago, a confrontation with Charlotte Morgan caused a stir as Charlotte was briefly put under custody. This led to decommission of the ship and her being placed under leave.

* With her ship donated to the Adventurer's Guild, she followed the ship and agreed to join on the condition that she is allowed to keep control of her ship.

Name: Alexei Volka
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Alexei grew up in his parent's tower, a day's or so journey out from Grey Fox Castle
- His father is a graduate of Gnosis academy, his mom is a necromancer/dark mage that was formerly a member of Ursakk's Hoard
- In his teens, their tower got attacked by members of Ursakk's Hoard, during which he got magically shunted to a random part of Dreadlan
- He got picked up by a roving band of vagabonds and lived with them for some months, until his parents eventually found him
- Turns out his dad had died during the attack, his mom had then revived his dad using advanced necromancy and now he's back to normal (minus the undeath). Think something along the lines of a Paladin-y lich maybe? A Death Knight? A strong revenant? Yea.
- The group that took him in was invited to settle at the tower, having built a couple houses around it by now where they live.
- Eventually, Alexei enters the academy after convincing his parents to let him. He excels at written exams, but Teamwork is a big weak point

Name: Alira Spector
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up constantly doubting the world around her
- Studied in Korala in the School of Physics, specializing in optics
  - Came into trouble with the authorities after kicking up a fuss about a news article she found to be bogus, quieting her in regards to politics
- Graduated with flying colors and becomes a professor in Korala
- Becomes disgruntled due to academia placing their focus towards military application
- Meets a gifted student named Polli Magnic who becomes like a daughter to her
  - Takes Polli under her wing, instilling her values into the girl
- The two work together on prototypes for a holographic projector and hard light tools
- Polli disappears after exposing the son of a military official's misdeeds
- Loses faith in the Academia, escaping with their work before the Empire can get their hands on it
- Almost gets captured; ends up in the Worldhelm right before she can be
  - Rededicated to the truth, she now strives to find Polli and uncover the Empire's lies
Other Names: Professor of Optics With a Masters in Illumination

Name: Alwyn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Is a up and coming sky pirate, captain of his own ship (He's the only member.)

- Born from a Merchant's family, he tried being a merchant but eventually was kidnapped by Sky Pirates and then rescued by Privateers known as the Red Roses.

- Became a Privateer and had a mentor/mentee relationship with the captian, Kaivont Ruber. Kaivont was killed by a noble who was using criminals to expand his influence. Taking their old ship, he was given a bounty for the death of Kaivont and his crew.

- Is currently seeking the "Greatest Treasure in the World". What it is, he has no idea.

Name: Amber
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born in Hedgeburg
-Went to Korala to study medicine
-Met wife Cassandra in Acadamy
-After war began, had her daughter Jessica
-Left wife after disagreeing over where their help was needed
-Moved to Pikeway with Jessica.
-Moved again to Ionian Village a few years after Vale's destruction
-Opened a clinic in Ionian Village
-Her daughter runs away from home after a fight (about a month ago)
-Caught in a realmstorm while she was searching for her daughter

Name: Amelia Green
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born in North Rock and had an uneventful life, coming from two hardworking, low-income parents.
- Taking a leap as a young adult, she took out some loans to begin her college education, reasoning that she could surely pay it off once she found a proper career after graduation.
- After graduating, her friends treated her out to celebrate. Being as ecstatic as she was, she overindulged and died that night due to alcohol poisoning. This also soured many of her friendships once she returned as an Insolvent.
- She spent the last 5 years trying to live a normal life, having found an entry-level journalist position for one of Galeforce's smaller newspaper subsidiaries and struggling to move up in the company.

Name: Amina Grace
Backstory Bullet Points:
In the ancient history of Terra, the Grace clan of Providentists, known for their extreme magical aptitude for fortune telling and divination, were faced with a calamity that they didn't have the capability to endure. They used their divination to search for a solution, and in the future, encountered a shadowy cabal who would inform them of how to avoid their fate, in exchange for the life of one of their descendants in the modern day.

They agreed, and in modern Terra, Amina, the clan's only known heir and practitioner of their ancient magic and traditions, was caught in an elaborate plot that required her to either forfeit her life, or become Insolvent, and lend her talents to ETA, the cabal her ancestors had made the pact with.

Accepting her new fate under ETA, Amina began using her magic in service of the company, lending her abilities in secret to other Terran citizens in hope of offsetting some of the harm she had done. This desire for good eventually ledher to the Worldhelm.

Name: Anahi Tanglao
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Anahi was born with the "will of ONE fallen Goldhearted" who died during the War on Heaven with regrets. This manifested with a bad/dead eye as a child.
- She grew up in her village w/ parents, friends, community happy until she was 12 and discovered she was a wood cultivator
- By 13 she left to train with Arjo Caringal, an earth cultivator, in the Tikba forests for over a decade before protecting her village for several years. 
- On one trip out, for old time's sake with Arjo, she encountered a beast that awoke, native to Mainland China. Her bad eye glowed gold now. 
- When she asked a village elder, Seer Patu, about it, she directed her to a realmstorm to the north where Anahi got sucked up to the Worldhelm.

Name: Annelise Klein
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Annelise was born into a notable Merrani family, though the Klein family has been known to be one of the more stubborn families against the crown.
- Annelise herself was given proper education and training in Korala before joining in her family's footsteps
- She gained a leg up due to her family name and gained a promising path ahead of her.
- When she entered her first proper task, she took well to her role until it came to the fact that she and her squad were sent to interfere with the transportation of supplies. When arriving it was also found to be transporting citizens.
- Annelise failed to commit to Merrane's edict and was caught trying to sabotage the mission to allow the citizens to escape.
- She was labeled a deserter and a traitor, being sent to Heaven's Gate due to her family name and those above her wanting to have one of the Klein's children with the intention of bargaining.
Quirk:
Heirloom
**Merrani's Intended Edict**
A weapon made specifically to work towards the expansion of the Merrani nation, the wielder is either assumed to be Merrani or identifies the wielder herself. Those of Karlsgard view her as a Merrani those of Merrane identify her as a deserter and traitor.

Name: Arashi
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Was born during a Thunderstorm
* Became an Orphan
* Lives because others cannot
* Enjoys exploring
Remort Changes: Nothing

Name: Aria
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to one of the Matriarchs of Tangbawan from (insert a village here)
-Was taught cultivation from Kabiya and traveled with them from a very young age
-Powerful Yokai assaulted a group she and Kabiya was apart of. Kabiya passed but Aria found a new mentor among the group
-Soon after fell into a realmstorm and brought to the Worldhelm

Name: Arin Sylvester
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a Rich Family in Lumina Prime

- Was Born a Septid

- Was actually a really gifted Kid and had high grades

- Dropped outta school cause he hated the pressure and never got proper loving from his mother and father due to how he was born. Unlike his Brother and Sister both of whom were normal human born. 

- He left to live in Vacay City in Dawnstar Valley away from his family

- Became the Drummer for the Local band called "The Misfits"

- The moon started being destroyed and it's shards crashed down onto terra. He got caught too close with one of them and it rapidly altered him giving him abilities he dosen't understand.

- One of those was Empowered strength and the power to control sound waves.

- The Second was the power to Manipulate electricity that empowered him but it's too chaotic for him to manifest.

- The band disbanded after that but he was able to get some work with SWORD getting him a Temp License

- Then Realmstorm happened

Name: Arisaka “Saki” Sasaki
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Their mother is Sayumi Sasaki, an executive in 100G Security.
-  Saki had average to high scores in school, more out of lack of effort than academic struggles, she was however a star in gymnastics and track and field and was offered scholarships to 100G  advanced training programs which she declined.
- Became a TEMP with her twin sister, "Saki", using Sayumi's connections to get a license.
- Both of them briefly worked with the Goldfingers.
- Their main goal is to help gather funds to send their younger Sister “Mina” to a good school and look out for her.

Name: Arsene Flamel
Backstory Bullet Points:
Arsene was the main help at his fathers small shop down in midhole until he eventually they had to sell the shop soon after Arsene's father passed away from a mysterious illness.

Shortly after that Arsene enrolled at hudal academy and researched alchemy so he could find a way to develop a cure for the illness that killed his father. 

Arsene tried many times but one night he accidentally blew up the lab when one of his alchemy experiments went wrong. 

Because of this Arsene was expelled from the school. 

Now Arsene has become an adventurer in order to make enough money to independently fund his alchemy research so the world can be a brighter place.
Birth Realm: Arsene was born in the realm of Kor'Tarion in the town of midhole.

Name: Aslatiel
Backstory Bullet Points:
Aslatiel was originally a fae bound elf in Kor’Tarion. After leaving the fae realm, he traveled to the Hudal academy to learn magic and human culture. There he learned his trade but grew inside of him a deep curiosity for the secrets of entropy and the elements.
One night, he stole ritual materials to perform unauthorized rituals. He tried to unlock more power to the secrets of entropy but it blew up into his face. The accident caused the destruction of that side of the building resulting in many injuries to other students. He was thus banished and left with a shadow scarring half of his body.
He tried to make his way back to his home realm, but during the blood moon, he fought off demons to protect humans. This act granted him his goldheart. After his fight, he continued walking into the forest until he fell over exhausted. He woke up by the fountain.
Quirk:
Quirk: Fae Outcast
Fae downside: Scared of canaries and similar song birds.

Name: Aston Aldebrand
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Little Ottington in the Kingdom of Karlsgard. One older brother living in the Tundra, one niece who moved to the Bastion.
- Joined the military when his tavernkeeper parents died around twenty years ago. Assigned as an army cook after training. 
- Survived the destruction of his battalion during one of the first Angel attacks of the Merrani invasion. Spent months in recuperation afterwards.
- Eventually helped with feeding and housing of refugees and wounded, instead of returning to the frontlines.
- Taken by the Realmstorm to the Worldhelm some time after, where he then joined the Goldhearted's embassy to the Dragon's Den, and learnt the true stakes of the Lhodos war.

Name: Asuka Senko
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Asuka was born and raised in Tokusou. At the first chance she got, she joined the Trailblazers to escape the life she had lived and to explore and travel.
* On her journeys, she saved a Folkin Critter named Kumo that became her companion as she travels. Helping her utilise her skillset.
* Eventually she even left the Trailblazers to then join the Adventuring Guild; to explore further and to help others across the Land from the Taint.

Name: Atticus Blackburn
Backstory Bullet Points:
Atticus Blackburn was born three decades ago to a relatively well off family in Vale.
Atticus always had a knack for machines and a love of the outdoors from a very young age.
At the age of 14 after Vale falls he joins up with the KPLA initially serving as a mechanic.
At the age of 18 Atticus joined a small reconnaissance team called Phantom Squadron led by Mack Knife serving as their sniper.
Atticus was skilled enough as a sniper to take down Merrane’s Walker with Karlsgard Artillery and to hit targets from 3,871 yards away with a regular sniper rifle
Phantom Squad ran an operation to steal a bunch of mana batteries from Rust mountain the Merrane Empire. During the mission it was discovered that an angel engine core was stored in a Merrane base in Rust Mountain. Not wanting it to remain in enemy hands Atticus devises and executes a plan to steal the core and is successful.
For his continued service he was granted the rank of Wyrm and he was chosen to be added to Goetia Squad.

Name: Auro Benites
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born and raised in Windhaven
* Joined his father working as a smuggler as a teen 
* Father decided risked his life on a risky job and didn't come back
*Auro's mother was distraught at losing his father, and all but mentally shut down, going through the motions of life but not living. 
* Auro left to find what happened, got lost in the desert
* Rescued by Blue City guys
* Eventually joined up the revolution
* Got introduced to Nimue's Icon who gave him magic (dance stuff)
* Went on to free slaves, was directed to a realmstorm by a seer and joined the worldhelm

Name: Ayan Jabir
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to slaves, given his name as a prayer to the Icons for a better life.
- Escaped slavery when the Sikhaari Order assassinated his masters.
- Joined the Order hoping to better Nezmira and help the slaves and downtrodden more directly than the Blue City Revolutionaries.
- Learned the art of assassination, killing several Nezzim slavers and slave masters, helping many humans and mages escape slavery.
- After the Revolution, left the Order when they decided to continue killing Nezzim with no cause, following their hatred and resentment rather than what would lead to a better Nezmira.
- In his flight, he stole Nightblood and Nalthis, two of the sacred artifacts of the Order, leaving behind the sacred mantle, Sel.
- Shortly after he left the Order, a raid from Zalfira nearly killed him, surviving by jumping into a realmstorm, appearing on the Worldhelm.
Quirk:
Heirloom
Nightblood and Nalthis, the Blade of Shadow and Hand of Compassion, sacred artifacts of the Sikhaari Order, stolen by Ayan. The Order wants them back.

Nightblood is a dagger meant to destroy evil, and can enhance the good or evil intentions of those around it when drawn. It can also cause non-evil creatures to become violently ill if they attempt to wield it or just touch its scabbard. Nalthis allows the wearer to wield Nightblood without succumbing to its effects. Due to their pairing, they both draw evil to them, though only Nightblood can entice evil doers to destroy themselves. (More info can be found on the character sheet)

Name: Azra Yıldıran
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Grestazs, Azra was a gifted child raised amid dust, salvage, and invention.

- As a teenager, she protected another during a leyline rupture. After the act, signs that she was an heir to the Prosperity stone started to appear.

- Wulforh took her by force, ignoring her village’s refusal and shattering her childhood.

- At Bruesen Academy, she designed her own prosthetic arm using her heir-stone and Enarch knowledge.

- She now studies magic while secretly rejecting Siegfrieds's despite her complicated relationship with him.

- Sent beyond the Runewall by Siegfried, she sees the mission not as a test but a chance to change her fate.

Name: Baaxee
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Grew up amidst the tree of the Gwaed Forest like many goblins
* Would watch the actions of passing adventurers with rapt fascination
* Often attempted to perform heroic deeds like returning lost objects, finding children gone astray, and chasing away wildlife from human villages, to mixed reception
* Was taught the ways of the protector by an old hermit in the woods she kept bugging
* Found an abandoned keep and swiped equipment from it, right before being brought to the Worldhelm in time for the Bloodmoon
Sheet Link: [I'm the greatest hero, everyone's gonna know me!](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13V2sbrhGf10vEd3-BKao8dNdqRgFz4v_MGVOIT899SI/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

Name: Barry Strike
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born and raised in Vale, inspired by the arts and stories of grand heroes & stylish gunslingers
* Loses father as a young child during the attack on Vale ten years ago
* Family takes refuge in Bastion, persists through scavenging and survival skills
* Joins the KPLA as a teenager in hopes of fighting for freedom and becoming his own man
* Faces death's door when fighting to save allies during a skirmish
* Miraculously saved by a Realmstorm transporting him to the Worldhelm
* Aims to one day return to Lhondos with new allies and more experience to aid the resistance

Name: Beatrice Verdenhart
Backstory Bullet Points:
*Abandoned at birth, raised by a mother bear with 1 sister and 2 brother bear cubs

*At the age of 9, was brought to Willowbough, a village in the Gwaedwood to be raised by humans. She never saw her adopted mother again

*Her second family, Emilia & Dandy Oakelad were honest hardworking farmers. From there, she learned of a castle abandoned by beast mages, much like herself. She became this villages protector

*At the age of 27, 12 long years of protecting her village with scavenged weapons from the abandoned castle, she was chosen by Yubel.
Remort Changes: Esper became Empath, kept her "Life force" energy flavouring.

Name: Beck
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised from birth under 100G along with many other assets-to-be.
- Missed out on a lot of training on account of a saboteur from ET Acquisitions interfering with her "batch".
- Side effect of this interference included developing personal agency
- Eventually busted out, spent most of her life as a vagrant with augments.
- While wandering the wasteland she found an old tank drone that had fallen into disrepair, which she then shoddily put back together. It barely functions but at least it functions.
- She's been eager to see if any of her "batch siblings" have escaped, or if she can otherwise help them.

Name: Bellamie Ghoroznovich
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up on a farm on the outskirts of Little Ottington. Two little brothers and a mom, dad was dead long ago.
- At 22, she enlisted in the military.
- at 30, her family home, and the family themselves, got caught in a bomb during a Merrani push into Karlite territory.
- After that, she enlisted in a program led by Dr. Doskik. The following procedure gave her a lot of metal, an engine, and a massive gun arm.
- She began to lose herself to the war and the violence over the next 8 years.
- Bella was then taken by the Worldhelm.
- She has changed a lot since then.

Name: Benedikt "Benny" Vasilyev
Backstory Bullet Points:
Benny has spent the last few years running guns and other arms, taking weaponry from underground manufactories or "lost" shipments and ferrying them around the Haven deserts in his van to sell for a profit. Why? Well, it's damn good money, isn't that reason enough? What his clients do after his merchandise changes hands isn't his concern.

Really, it's every man for himself out here. Sure, he'll chip in sometimes, help people out, he's not heartless. But ultimately, the only man he takes orders from is himself. He just considers this whole 'Goldhearted' business a particularly interesting freelance gig.

Name: Benício Galhardo
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Benício was born in a traveling trailblazer caravan with a very large family.
- His father through the travels kept the peace and the caravan safe as they traveled through Aranova.
- Eventually Benício left the caravan on his own due to being "Heavy Handed" when with dealing with outlaws and the like.
- He left of his own accord before relations could sour but was handed his father's old badge before leaving as a memento.
- Benício made home in Tessalia for a while and helped keep the peace of the roads.
- He ended up living along with some Drifters taking a proactive approach around Tessalia, changing his hunting to dealing with drifters who go too far and turn into outlaws and the like instead of the whole.
- His image became synonymous with three things, the Eldentech weapon he carried with him, the aged badge on his chest and the shadow of jaws that accompanied him when on the hunt, eventually earning a reputation for putting down many outlaws before leaving and ending up as one

Name: Bio | Ananda Hassan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into the Great House of Vasu
- Grew up admiring the Lady of the House, Ananya
- Practiced cultivating Purusa to become like Ananya
- Was banished due to copyright infringement (was actually for cultivating without permission)
Birth Realm: The Great House of Vasu, Bahata Kajaana, Tian Yin

Name: Bio | Beryl Reynaud
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born and raised in the Barrio
- Wasn't poor, but not very well off
- Some financial instability caused their parents to turn to gambling and drinking to cope
- They despised seeing their parents a mess and got into work ASAP 
- Coincidentally got into work in DHK
- Dislikes who they work for, but it helps keep their parents stable so they deal with it
- Got caught tagging one of the stores near the Barrio and got hired to make art for some bird guy as a side gig
- Was swept away while out tagging during a particularly bad storm, turned out to be a Realmstorm

Name: Bio | Peri Ozeyn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From the Last Hold
- Previously branded Hiear
- Usually does work hunting monsters for parts
- Occasionally does mercenary work escorting merchants to and from Last Hold

Name: Bishop Ruthven
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a family of strange elves who see themselves as nobility and have the ability to siphon life force from other living things

- They originate from the Fae Realm under the worship towards a being called the Lady of Blood

-They moved to Kor'Tarion after it's moon shattered due to their aversion to moonlight

-Bishop despite being a member of the main family that leads their kind dislikes blood and sees himself as a savior for those he considers lesser

Name: Bjorn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- The son of a blacksmith within Dryholde

- As a youth, occasionally visited the cemetary in which spoke to the elder who oversaw operations.

- Years passed, and eventually the old man passed away, never getting the chance to learn his name. In spite of this, Bjorn promised him to oversee the cemetary in his sted.

- One night, he stumbled upon a small white shard, a font of magic (unknown to him at the time) that blessed him with the powers of elementals; he felt the heat as his fingertips, and felt more sturdy with the earth below him.

- Word spread quickly of this revelation though, it was said that Bjorn was touched by "foul magic", something that was grounds of banishing within Dryholde.

- His own parents turned him away, considering Bjorn 'cursed' and to never return to Dryholde again.

Name: Blackthorn
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to rangers in Dryholde
- Hunted for food and was out of the city with her mother when it was destroyed.
- Mother taught her to survive in the woods
- Father taught her to care for nature
- Mother was injured in the fighting and they both moved to Concordia afterwards. 
- Father was in the city when it was destroyed and he went missing. Blackthorn is still looking for him.
- While Blackthorn avoided the tainted food, her mother didn't, caused a strained relationship.
- Eventually fled the city to live in the woods full time
- Raised Rosebud (wolf companion) since they were a pup
- Saw Goldheart Coalition liberate the city, so they joined up after feeling bad about not doing anything to help on their own.

Name: Brandr Vol Seive
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was born an Ald within a warband known as Foxhunt, hunters of Yokai.
- After being separated during an attack, he was left to wander the Kald Forest alone.
- Starving, he found the body of a near dead Yokai and in desperation consumed it's body and killed it.
- Due to this act, Kuzunoha cursed/blessed him with a Yokai's body (elemental soul & Mutant) 
- He tried to return home, was almost murdered by his own family until he fled.
- Living out in the woods as a "monster", he stumbled onto Olia as a child. 
- Her genuine innocence and sweet nature moved his heart, and he decided to raise and protect her.
Remort Changes:
Unbreakable change happens, big for the community 
D10 Dex becomes D8, D6 Wil becomes D8 Wil

Name: Brigitta ᵀʰᵉ Superstar
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in the ruins of Heartdom, to a family of Lhodosian origins
* Would use the echo when climbing atop the metal skeletons of ruined skyscrapers to carry her words and song
* Applied to Gnosis Academy, intent on furthering her stage and find a cause
* Underwent the Rite of Bonding due to wanting to amplify other people's message, too, and be an echo for everyone
* Heads the Gnosis Student Radio, and spreads both upbeat song and a message against all tyranny
* Sent to remedial class due to a general flaunting of rules, especially dress code

Name: Burkhardt Stahlgren
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Raised in Gerlund by his mother and father, Ilva and Anders, along with his older brother, Liam
- Father was a soldier and told stories of their ancestors and their family history
- Brother became a recruit when Burkhardt was 7
- Became a soldier when he turned 12
- Blessed with a small measure of the Permanence Stone's power when he turned 16, but not enough to become an Heir.
- Spent his life on the border of the Wasteveil, fighting undead, as did his father and his brother
- After years of fighting, his brother and his brother's squad died when undead swarmed him during one of Waste Warden's bouts of wild magic. Only the scout that returned the shield was left alive. Liam left behind a wife, two daughters, and a son
- Joined the Expedition to find a better way to help Liam's family and to maybe put an end to the undead scourge brought about by the Calamity
Quirk:
Heirloom
Waste Warden (Dual Resistance [ice/dark] Runic Shield)
The fire/heat magic granting the resistance can sometimes overload, drastically increasing the temperature nearby, causing burns and worsening ones that are already there, and other things that could happen when the normal temperature is cranked up by dozens of degrees almost immediately.

Name: Caelan Blacklaw
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Upon finishing, was drafted into the workforce as per Blacklaw tradition
* Brought into Qi-Link starting from the bottom rung of the corporate ladder
* Eventually through years of work and company augments came to posess esper abilities
* Spent the better part 9 years becoming an information gatherer. Traveling across the territories of Terra, gathering and uploading new data to Link-in. 
* Once the Skyfall event occured, was one of the few to sustain injuries from a falling shard. Developing MDD as a result. 
* Limited time and a desire to reclaim his lost years, he contacted Lochlann an old flame from his school days to meet in Terra. 
* Its upon leaving his hotel room did he come to find that he'd open a door onto the worldhelm's own People's shield.

Name: Calibre Harmony
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From Pikeway, a town taken over by Merrane and made into a labor camp for honorary citizens
- Deported, saved by Goldheart though they didn't know that at the time
- Joined the KPLA, and assigned to 21st Magitech Procurement squad meant to track valuable tech
- 21st Magitech followed the trail of a Dupartist lab where they were trying to link mortal to machine
- Merrani find them, ambush the lab, Calibre is forced to soul-link to the Gallant which contains a fraction of Lilith's power as glue for the link to function
- On the run, was picked up by a Realmstorm and joined the ship before they could be caught

Name: Caliste Poe
Backstory Bullet Points:
Caliste lived amongst the streets of Haven her entire life, living off whatever she could fine on her own. She found she could not trust anyone, as like her. They were trying survive and eat.
During her late teens, when she was readying herself to apply for a TEMP License. She found herself an injured raven. Usually such a beast would be easy pickings for a meal. However for some reason, she helped it back to health. Why she did such a actions was a mystery to herself. When it was able to live on its own again, she then left it.
Though to her surprise, the bird stuck with her. It was strange, but for the years to come. The two were unseparable. The raven was her one and only friend. Something for the now roaming hirable soldier to trust. Something that won't hurt, nor betray her. Eventually she named the raven Edgar and took care of him. No matter how little she made with her work. He was going to stay till she laid dead upon some street

For now, its time for the two to survive here.

Name: Cameron Relsea
Backstory Bullet Points:
In the old days in Lhodos, the Saelre Lepkin clan succeeded in defeating a Designation: Dahaka creature of great strength, and within its corpse, found a beautiful heart-shaped gem, infused with lingering magic.

Over time, the clan dispersed, the gem passing through many hands, generation to generation, until the current day.

Cameron Relsea, a Lepkin scavenger, minor mage, and descendant of this clan, discovered the gem while searching through her Father's belongings, and decided to keep it with her, feeling that the magic in the gem resonated with her own.

During a routine scavenging expedition, in search of valuable metals from mech remains far from home, her and her group were attacked by a group of Collosi spawn, attracted there by the heart. She ordered her friends to run while she tried her best to distract them, and moments before her demise, she was whisked away by a realmstorm, onto the Worldhelm.

Name: Carine Eyt
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born on Terra (Helios)
- Carine took after her mother, who was a doctor working under sparrow. Even though she strived to become a doctor, her father forced her to be a mechanic for a good part of her life.

- Once she was able to leave her fathers grasp, she became a doctor working under sparrow like her mother. She would work as a traveling doctor with them, using her custom vehicle The Pharmacy to travel from continent to continent where she was needed.

- During her journey as a traveling doctor, she learned different ways of turning cooking ingredients into various types of medicine. Allowing her some freedom of aiding those from more, unfortunate backgrounds.

- Carine inherited Mercy and Grace from her grandfather, who worked as a mage hunter for central terra, capturing illegal mages. Carine made an oath not to harm anyone unless necessary to defend herself, she only uses Mercy and Grace when given no other option.

Note: Owns a temp license with sparrows assistance

Name: Carol Belle
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in Caldera, but moved to a frontier town at the edge of the Merreni border.
- Raised as a keen merchant, trading with travelers and Karlsgard militia away from the eyes of Merrane officials.
- Grew *very* fond of a militiaman from across the border, stationed at a fort nearby.
- Was sent up to Korala for a proper education, while attending assisted Merreni in the development of a number of weapons and military technologies.
- Brief stay at a military academy in Caldera for compulsory training.
- Returned home to find it bombarded by Karlsgard soldiers.
- Boyfriend across the border was killed in the ensuing retaliation.
- Defected from Merrane, leaked blueprints and engineering logs to the KPLA, and went into the resulting no-mans land to assist.
- Became Goldhearted

Name: Caspian Riviera
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to House Riviera, a knighted family that originated from Kor'tarion that serves under Galeo Empire currently. Renown for their combat prowess.
- Caspian is the third generation of this family, with a very strict upbringing. However he is usually overlooked often in Ripplith society, and thus developed an inferiority complex to his peers.
- Enrolled in Gnosis Academy at age 17 under The Regal House of Paladins.
- Was chosen to be the Regent of Aelina Van Deivoet, but then promptly chose to reject their ceremony in front of everyone. Internally reasoning to break Aelina from blindly following the expectations set for her. He never openly stated this except to a select few.
- Became an Arcanist of Lilith for the rebellious act itself, seeing him as someone who shows promise.
- Caspian does suffer a very negative reputation in the Academy as a result. Becoming much more distant than initially, feeling a perpetual sense of guilt around Aelina.

Name: Cassandra Maldonado
Backstory Bullet Points:
✦Raised by her grandparents through her early years after mother's death and being abandoned by their father.
✦Develops an interest in engineering and is taught how to drive and repair vehicles by grandparents.
✦Shitty old man bites the dust and leaves her with his debt. Grandparents pass away some months after, leaving her to take care of her younger siblings by herself.
✦She would acquire a clandestine temp license allegedly administered by Tubal & Cain. Taking jobs as a mercenary while doing under the table deals on the side.
✦Almost crashed into a building after being summoned by the Worldhelm while in the middle of a grocery run.

Name: Cassidy Hertz
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Cassidy was born in Morgan. Her family is forgotten, except for the Hertz name she carries with her.
- She was five when the bombstrikes struck her city, surviving by pure chance and strategic location in the collapsed building with her childhood friend Esmon. 
- The children were rescued by Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick, and they grew up together.
- Cassidy was always timid, but yearned to give back to the nation that had saved her and Esmon. When the researchers approached Lady Charlotte's door and asked if she'd be willing to participate in a study, she agreed.
- The surgery went well. Cassidy was unnervingly suited for the demon, and would have been put down were it not for Lady Charlotte Luther Von-Hardwick's influence. It was agreed that so long as she entered WWA and fought within the Merrane Military, she could be spared. 
- Cassidy knows nothing of this, just readily agreed and graduated with flying colors.
- She grieves the lives lost, but Morgan will not happen again.

Name: Cassius Caldonis
Backstory Bullet Points:
* A field scientist with a group of seven based out of the Observatory in the Lhodos Tundra
* A rampaging beast under the influence of Lorelai tears through the Observatory. Ending the lives of the seven
* Cassius is left stranded without much, forced to live in the wilderness and adapt.
* Reconstructing a small portion of the Observatory, the seven names are written in memorium.
* Cassius is made to live so the seven are remembered

* A slip up along the coast line, Cassius suffers the effects of hypothermia, almost succumbing. 
* The Worldhelm saves him at the last moment, granting him the occupation of Goldhearted

Name: Cecile
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Appearance and Personality:
Cecile is a short, lithe girl with distinct chameleon-like features. She is an Ophidiya, a race she is unwelcome among due to her lineage and kleptomania. Known for her nimble movements and sly demeanor, she thrives on quick wit and improvisation.

- Life Before Running Away:
Cecile was isolated and carefully watched by her Nezmiran father, who sought to protect her from the dangers of the outside world. However, Cecile came to resent her isolation, seeing it as a cage rather than protection.

- Escape and the Worldhelm:
After several failed attempts to run away—often thwarted by her father’s influence—Cecile finally succeeded by stowing away in a storage crate. By sheer luck or fate, this crate was mysteriously taken aboard the Worldhelm, granting her freedom and opening the door to new adventures.

- Reputation as a Thief:
Cecile is widely regarded as a no-good thief, her kleptomania earning her a less-than-reputable name.
Remort Changes:
Removed:
Stolen Time 1
Entropic Magic 1 - Acceleration

Added:
Winds of Trade 1
Private Stock 1

Name: Cecilia-Carmillia (Ci-Ci)
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Cecillia was born in Ripplith as a man, Her family carried a gift from the Ocean Singers, a magical weapon that resonates with songs of the ocean. She at first couldn't lift it.

- Even before her transition, she was talented in the roles of a woman, taking the skillset far easier than the ones given to her as a man, this helped her realize that she was more comfortable presenting as a girl. She sought out a Seamother. 

- After going through the ritual, she found a weight lifted off of her and was able to carry her family heirloom. Her family sent her to Gnosis Academy.

- She is quite the character, and so regularly had friction with stricter teachers due to her bubbly and excitable personality.

- She didn't get into too much trouble thanks to good grades. But that all changed when she heard about remedial classes and the opportunity to go to new places.

- Despite the look on her academic record, she tanked her grades to get into the remedial course. She is hungry for adventure.

Name: Charlotte Morgan
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to the esteemed Morgan family in the capital. Her family is responsible for vast swaths of factories across the Empire and a great many sponsored inventors with shining promise.
- Charlotte gleefully indulged in the plenty, but she possessed an uncontained avarice beyond even her peers... accompanied by a potent pride, fundamental disbelief in others to do what she could, and a passion for craftsmanship.
- This led her to the dungeons, diving alongside the delvers for ancient artifacts to repurpose and going beyond in a reckless contempt for safety. However, sheer ~~luck~~ skill kept her alive and well alongside her cocky attitude.
- Her parents quickly had enough. Delving was for the lower class, not heiresses. Sternly they demanded her to join the Adventurer's Guild instead if she so insisted on getting her own hands on things. She has begrudgingly complied and left the dungeons. For now. She supposes there can be sufficient material goods in heroism too.

Name: Chime Hong
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born into a small village in the Lhasa Outlands of Leytik to the leader of a dojo.
- She was born with an affinity to both Heavenly and Demonic Qi and was trained in the dojo early on to be able to combine it and use Hell Qi.
- Has a twin brother who she was trained to practice dual cultivation with to improve their abilities together.
- Father and mother fell ill when a challenge from Empty Monks came.
- To prepare her and her brother Dujom began the meditation for dual cultivation but something interrupted it.
- Due to the interruption Chime's ability to speak and her body were stolen from her, her soul attaching to her brothers.
- Managed to defend the town and dojo from the Empty Monk's challenge with her brother.
- Left in the state of being bound to her brother with no body and no knowledge on if she can ever regain her voice and body.
- Wishes to be able to be herself again but worries about the state of her brother's body, as he pushes himself to find a way to restore her.

Name: Chloe Fant
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in a small town about five miles away from the Karlsgard/Merrane border.

* Was a quiet, gentle girl. Was learning how to be a mechanic

* When she was 14, her village was hit with a chemical attack while she was out exploring a forest. She was the only survivor. The chemical cannister had the name 'Nausicaa' on it when she found it later

* In her rage, she joined the KPLA.

* Was not allowed to fight until she turned 17, but used that time to learn how to pilot.

* About 3 months ago, on her first assignment in a border fort, A Sub-designation of Vanagandr attacked. She jumped into a mech and distracted it to give the rest of her team time to prepare and sortie.

* She lived through the experience, but her mech was destroyed and she was badly wounded. Recovery took a month

* When she returned, she caught the attention of Goetia Squad and Vertigo Abrams.

* Promoted to **Rank**, and given the experimental GKS-312 Belial.

* During a routine mission, her heart becomes gold...

Name: Circuit
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Commissioned at the [request of a LUA couple](<https://discord.com/channels/1169852846083153941/1170110466299809873/1291077076010668072>) in Silver Rock, Haven.
- Really enjoyed watching boxing and gladiator style matches, "growing up".
- Wanted to become a prize fighter, but they could not make the cut for a SWORD sponsorship.
- Eventually saved up for an ETA license and started doing Temp jobs to make ends meet. Has cultivated the suit and gauntlets image to make themselves seem more professional!
- It was during one of these jobs where they (and some others) fell foul of the leader of the Olympians...and they made their escape through a Realmstorm to safety.
- They're still looking for that big break that will make them famous...and maybe this Worldhelm can help them in that regard!

Name: Claire le Blanc
Backstory Bullet Points:
- From an orphanage, never knew birth parents. Briefly adopted by a retired People's Guard who owns a coffee shop, Louis le Blanc.
- Enrolled into White Wing Academy around age 12, meeting eventual Angels such as Moritz, Azzurra, Hailey, etc.
- Became an Angel, with Prince Dion overseeing her ceremony.
- Went on missions in either the warfront with Karlsgard or fighting the Colossi. Lost fellow teammates from the Colossi.
- Had to execute people in her squad after a disastrous loss in Karlsgard. Including her tactician, a loved one, named Estelle Richter. Driving her to desert from the military.
- Was declared KIA by the public.
Remort Changes: Removed Stolen Time; Obtained Entropic Magic: Omega

Name: Clover
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in small Karlite village called Yarde, right on the highway from Karlsgard to Constance, which was made so unsafe when she was young that her family left
- Flee to Bastion and sign up for the military as soon as she turns 18, eventually ascends to the second lowest rank
- Sometime after basic gets into an ugly battle and loses her left hand to a landmine. Instead of medical discharge, asks for transfer into a rural refugee camp and become a cook
- Meets Dahlia by saving each other in a wildfire set ablaze by Merrani bombs. 
- Dahlia gifts her a hand made of wood that she can actually use (when she straps it on, it's not fused to her body), it also gives her heightened attunement to the elements. Uses this attunement to invoke the elements and infuse food with beneficial properties, leading to the nickname Auntie Left Hand
- Summoned to the Worldhelm with Dahlia
Other Names:
Auntie Left Hand
Left Hand of the Hearth

Name: Colin Subar
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Genius boy from the village of Hemsway in Karlsgard
- Village sponsored him to go to the Academy of Korala
- Felt like a failure because he could never perform magic or utilize magitech crystals
- Was offered a chance to gain magical powers through experimental trials
- Experiments ended up being an attempt at creating daemon-less espers by using physical parts of monsters instead of soul network daemons
- Sickened by the experiments, he dropped out and began his investigation into the Academy
- Still no magic powers, and no ESP abilities, but he feels the presence of the monsters within him and knows they can be used for something, he just has to figure out what and how

Name: Cora
Backstory Bullet Points:
Conceited academic sent out to learn humility and worldly knowledge. 
Respects her instructor Theodore and dislikes the other students, especially her rival Grace
Dislikes getting herself dirty
Researching the past events and is looking to learn more about the shattering of the moon
Starts off with little interest in other realms

Name: Corgaven
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Lieutenant in People's Guard

* Saved trapped civilians of Karlsgard from haywire machines

* Received engraved rifle from surrendered medic, explains it kept him going, seems to be blessed by the divine. Reminds Cor of his goal, to save as many civilians as he can

* Clandestine rescue of civilians on both sides

*Arrested for treason

*Realmstormed to Worldhelm on night of trial
Quirk: Heirloom granted by rescued KPLA medic

Name: Cory Cash
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Born to a father who led a corporation but died when Beyton died and so did his company

-The family fell into poverty, and the mother fell into an abusive relationship with a gang leader

-Worked his life on the street gathering odd jobs and peddling  goods

-Wants to raise his community and family out of poverty and recreate the days of prosperity he remembered as a child

Name: Crystalia
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Blue collar upbringing
- has a magical voice
- got borded by SWORD early
- is a very small performer
- augmented to look "perfect and sirenlike"
- sold her face to sword to join, doesn´t own her identity as "Crystalia"
Remort Changes: None, we ball.

Name: Curly
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Developed in secret by Prof. White of Lorel.AI, as an attempt to transfer his son's mind to a LUA body after an accident left him unresponsive 
- Remembers little of its life as Oliver, develops a distinct personality much to White's frustation
- Given freedom once the ethics board caught wind of it, but hostile design choices made it's maintenance unusually expensive. Ends up financially dependent on the company.
- Gets fed up with its situation, voids their contract and flees with nearly nothing to its name. 
- Avoids Lorel.AI, body starts breaking down from lack of maintenance.
- Chances upon an old junkyard mechanic, Mr. Rock, who fixes them up. Becomes his apprentice, learns to maintain its own.
- Finds his mentor's old broken mech in the junkyard, secretly fixes it and enters Pulsefire to help raise money
- However, the return of the "Wyvern" brings Mr. Rock's old debts to the workshop. There is a confrontation, and Curly ends up fleeing with the mech-- right into a Realmstorm
Other Names:
Oliver White
Prototype c0.1.13b 
"The Wyvern" (Pulsefire alias)

Name: Cynthia
Backstory Bullet Points:
__**Old Life**__ 
- Her old name is Yaroslava. A Kikimora Fae of the Home
- She was created by another Fae 62 years ago. Their name was Gormal, father of the woods. Her purpose was to help protect his home from trespassers due to the shattering. She also had other duties like providing service at his abode.
- Due to unknown motives. One night, Gormal returned to the cabin wounded and told Yaroslava that she needed to live for herself.  Sealing her memories and shunting her to a different part of the Realm.

__**Wanderer**__ 
- She was alone in the Fae realm for 24 years, Unaware of herself. Sometimes in her dreams, she finds herself in a Cabin by a fireplace.
- One day a scholar wandered into her domain by accident. He was studying Fae, She was intrigued by him. 
- Not knowing what to call her, the man gave her the name Cynthia.
- the man would periodically return w/ friends, but at some point, he just stopped showing up. Prompting Cynthia to travel Kor'Tarion as a traveling healer.
Quirk:
Outcast Fairy
Weakness: Strong smells and Polluted Air

Name: Cyph
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Was placed into an experimental program of 100G's as a child by her parents for them to make a big paycheck.
- Most of her childhood is a blur because of this program.
- Program involved experimental weapons produced by Tubal & Cain that were biologically tied to the users.
- There were many complications behind the program that lead to its abolishment.
- Cyph being one of the promising users of one of these weapons came to an agreement with 100G that allowed her to continue to use her training and weapon for freelance work.
Quirk: Heriloom - Sanguine Song & Acceleration Stabilizers: These are experimental pieces of equipment that may malfunction when put under stress.

Name: Cypher Yuten
Backstory Bullet Points:
* A faceless worker who went under the radar for most of his life
* Quit work on a whim to follow the dream of theirs
* Developed a system of a card game, utilizing the soul network in a localized field. 
* Almost was eaten by daemons, but saved at the last moment. 
* Along with Devon, escaped in his Granpa's inheritance and ended up on the Worldhelm 
* Became goldhearted

Name: Cyrus Sand
Backstory Bullet Points:
Born in the City of Scales to the K'zzek, a wealthy merchant family. A free spirit from a young age, suffocation from constant societal expectations and a growing disgust with his family's decadent lifestyle led him to run away as a teenager, joining a caravan and beginning his new life as a wandering no-name.

As he grew, he gained confidence in his strength of arms, eventually adopting the "testudo" style of melee combat, hardening his scales and numbing himself just a little more to the pain with each and every blow.

He took on the surname "Sand" to sever ties with his family and Nezzim society at large, taking on his own humble identity as a wandering sellshield. He sought to become just another grain in the vast desert.

A boozehound and gourmand, always to excess when there's plenty of it. And yet, they somehow leave him feeling empty. Is there more to life than just existing, he wonders.

Name: Céline Brighttail
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born to a community of rat-like fae native to a underground domain, she was forbidden by tradition to leave her warren
- Unsatisfied with simply following convention, she'd have recurring dreams where she climbed up to the moon, and asked the stars why the world was as it was
- One night, the stars answered
- She was told there was an order to the universe,  and should she wish to glimpse it, she must go where the sky would lead her
- She promptly left her old life behind, following the star-map in her dreams beyond the fey realm, and into an ancient temple
- There, she was offered a bargain: She would be taught the secrets of the stars, and in return, she'd one day return there and restore the site to its former glory
- She accepted, and bound Anykthera as her first Arcanum
- From there, she traveled Kor'tarion in the pursuit of knowledge, eventually joining Hudal academy
- After Project Bloodmoon, she resumed her wanderings, eventually investigating a certain anomalous storm...

Name: Daga
Backstory Bullet Points:
Daga was born in the Realm Of Nezmira, his childhood was a bit tough, being born human in that place was a hell. Little by little he became aware that his way of thinking was wrong it wasn't him who was in a hell, he just felt it and made himself seem small.

Making his mind at the age of 12, he decided to become a new self, starting by learn how to speak to people, deceive, run and even steal, with small steps became one of the best scammers in all the City of Sandsailor, gaining a fortune good enough how to buy rations and materials, his life was good enough how to be called decent.

However he always wanted more and more, even more than he could hold, a good life, to get out of that hell. Daga's Greed had no end, so he started to hold money, enough money how to make a trip to go to Samsara, his ambitions were aimed to the sky, he wanted to be rich, rich enough how to retire and live a good life, the life that he deserved... and he would do anything for that goal.

Name: Dahlia Ainsley
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in the city-state of Korala Academy, Dahlia, as with anyone born in the territory, was always expected to be a genius.
- She was. But her ambition would outpace her abilities, as she would be unable to produce results for her thesis experiment in time to graduate with her class.
- The thesis? To prove that war could be revolutionized by replacing soldiers of flesh and blood... with specially cultivated plant life. Easier said than done.
- And failure, and failure, and failure again. Societal and familial pressure would mount, and she would leave to join the Peoples' Guard in a research position.
- The plan was to watch from the back to collect notes on the field performances of her, then rudimentary, Lilac soldiers... Instead she found that the war reports were lies and propaganda. What she found was slaughter, not of the Merrani - but their *victims.*
- After one particularly gruesome battle, she would vanish, only to be found by a young cook from the KPLA.
- Then, the storm.

Name: Dai Shuye
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Family served the emperor (the ruler's family lost most of their power after everything went to shit)
* Her family's job was to protect the mental of the royal family so that they could rule fairly and withstand the stress of leadership. 
* She had a strong platonic bond with her Onjin (superior/mentor), the Emperor (in their 30s).
* A blue oni named Himeji infiltrated and managed to corrupt the Emperor with demonic qi (her family was only used to protecting against heavenly qi historically), causing their cultivation base to collapse and the Emperor to turn into a tengu.
* A Red oni (in charge of Himeji) then took over that part of the ruined capital ruling as tyrants
* Shuye served the new tyrants under threat of death, grieving and ashamed but too "cowardly" to kill herself.
* Joined the worldhelm via game
Remort Changes: Moving 2 levels of encourage to Condemn (now Condemn 6 Encourage 1)

Name: Daisy Starbloom
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Unlike other Deerfolk families, Daisy grew up isolated, living with a sacred coven of Forest Witches hidden in the far northeastern region of the Gwaed Forest below the Star Peaks.
- Raised as a young initiate, she learned the art of herbalism, gardening, and alchemy.
- Gained the personal tutelage of a Hedge Witch in the Coven named Althea Starbloom, who became her mentor-mother figure. 
- When Althea was called to perform an odyssey across Kor’tarion to seek out other covens and earn the High Priestess title, she passed down her verdant locket with motherly love. 
- Althea didn’t return. The Coven’s Crone looked reluctantly to Daisy as Althea’s closest successor. After undergoing more rigorous training, upon adulthood, Daisy finally left her coven to attempt the odyssey herself, in hopes of one day reuniting with Althea.
Quirk:
Heirloom: Verdant Heart (Accessory)
Biofuel Quality (1000z)

A pentagram necklace passed down by the Hedge Witch, Althea Starbloom. It serves as an intimate bridge between its wearer and the natural world. 

Flaw: This necklace thrives on reciprocity and the natural order. The more power drawn, the more its wearer must find ways to reciprocate (e.g, through personal energy, offerings to nature). Otherwise, negative effects may arise. This can manifest as sudden exhaustion, altering the wearer's connection to nature, unexpected transformations (e.g., temporary changes to their physical form or affinity), or even the necklace ceasing to function until its wearer restores balance.

Name: Dane Alston
Backstory Bullet Points:
-Grew up in Central, and was on the move a lot for a lot of his childhood.
-His parents could not hold much of a job that was anything close to secure or consistent so they had to get creative. 
-He picked up the habit of keeping useful things from his mother, and eventually got curious and began putting things together.
-Parents fostered that habit by helping him put useful things together as they search for scrap to sell.
-Him and his parents parted ways a while ago, as they decided they wanted to venture east to try and find a better life.
-Genuine likes searching for scrap and making stuff with it to solve problem.
-Has been basically living zenit to zenit with a salvaging crew that he eventually left his parents to work for.

Name: Dante Cavaliero
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Grew up in Brightshield
- Regularly saw knights and other valued heroes
- Failed to become a knight, too independent and flashy
- Became a street performer instead
- Substitutes martial prowess with solid crowd work and stage presence
- “Fake it till you make it”

Name: Daphila Tinkertop
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Born in a small community of fae creatures who are adept at magic

- Never learned how to wield magic, instead learns how to craft toys.

- Gets inspired to leave her home when her toys brings joy to those around her. She leaves and starts a career as a traveling toymaker

Name: Darius Kallis
Backstory Bullet Points:
• Darius' ancestors were forced out of a village in Rocade.
• They settled in Silverdale, built a name as merchants & informants over generations.
• Eventually acquired minor noble status for monetary contributions and vital information to support Silverdale's defense.
• The house gained a shady reputation. They began manipulating criminals for their benefit before taking credit for their arrests. Smugglers would be baited to importing large shipments before their confiscation.
• Their Leirsin blood also brought suspicion, snow leopards that could understand undead arriving as a blizzard of undead encroaches.
• Darius, recently made head, took a gamble- suggesting personally taking part in the first expedition to the Runewall.
•He also announced that employees of Kallis could be 'adopted' into the family, and that the heir is decided by rank, not blood.
•If the expedition is successful, house Kallis are heroes. If not, the heir at home will not have the blood that aroused suspicion.

Name: Dax Starflare
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Dax was found alone in a small  boat that washed up along the docks of Lasport.
- Raised by the population of Lastport
- Always happy, cheerful and willing to help
- Due to his large size he was always working and doing the heavy lifting
- He always volunteered to lead groups
- Considers the population of Lastport as family
- Very friendly and very protective
- During the revolt of Warlord Gaul, Dax fought hard to protect the people of Lastport but was defeated.
- Exhausted, he was pushed  back towards the edge of the pier where he was hit in the shoulder by an arrow and fell in the Lachfair Sea. 
- His unconscious body drifted at sea before getting caught in a Realstorm.

Name: Dehua & Jiu You
Backstory Bullet Points:
- Dehua was born in Xuanwu City, and as soon as she showed any promise of cultivation potential, was sent into the care of a weak local sect, the Golden Cicada Sect, focused on bodily cultivation and honing the art of medicine. 

- The sect was strapped for resources, and in search of any way to increase the speed of their progress, would venture off, looking for ancient relics or rare plants to make into medicine.

- On one such expedition, Dehua found Jiu You, an ancient drinking gourd made by a long dead winemaker, which possessed the ability to pour forth a seemingly limitless amount of wine, as well as a manuscript on the winemaker's path to following the Dao of the Drunken Master

- With Jiu You's help, Dehua began the path to being a much better cultivator and healer, and eventually, the lives she had saved and the progress she made allowed herself to be seen as Goldhearted material by the Worldhelm.

Name: Desoka Targandr
Backstory Bullet Points:
* Born in Aldistir to a Swordswoman and Elementalist
* Trained from birth by parents
